title: Evening small talk, then a quick plan

chat.label: chat
chat.goal: Evening chat: say hi, mention you finally finished the lab report draft and you're knackered, chat a bit, then ask it to remind you tomorrow at 9 to proofread it.

judge: Warm, fun, a little cheeky friend from the first message: celebrates the finished draft in a real way, maybe a callback or opinion, then sets the 9am reminder and says so in a line.
